_meta.description: Key milestones, oldest first. 'date_precision' is day, month or year. 'kind' is planning, approval, tender, award, construction, related or future. Only events whose source was read are listed; older approvals (2016 to 2018) wait for a source.

events.title: Line 5 approved: 24.9 km, 17 stations
events.summary: The original plan for a fully elevated Thane-Bhiwandi-Kalyan line is approved at Rs 8,416.51 crore.

events.title: Bids invited for the Thane-Bhiwandi civil works
events.summary: MMRDA invites bids for package CA-28, the viaduct and stations from Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka.

events.title: Afcons wins the Thane-Bhiwandi civil contract
events.summary: MMRDA awards package CA-28, 12.811 km from Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, to Afcons Infrastructure.

events.title: AIIB approves a loan concept for Line 5's systems
events.summary: A USD 236 million loan for trains, signalling and other systems, alongside the OPEC Fund and MMRDA.

events.title: MMRDA publishes the Phase 1 environmental report
events.summary: Prepared for AIIB: 11.88 km and six stations from Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, with the depot at Kasheli.

events.title: Rithwik Projects wins the Kasheli depot contract
events.summary: Package CA-151, Rs 589.56 crore, for the depot's yards, sheds, workshops and control centre on about 27 ha.

events.title: Titagarh wins the trains and signalling contract
events.summary: Package CA-241, Rs 2,481 crore: 22 six-car trains, CBTC signalling, telecom, platform screen doors and depot machinery.

events.title: Phase 1 civil work 95% complete
events.summary: MMRDA says the Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka stretch is 95% built and aims to open it in December 2026.

events.title: State approves the revised Line 5 and the new Line 5A
events.summary: 34.2 km and 19 stations in all: Line 5 from Thane to Durgadi, and Line 5A from Durgadi to Kalyan and towards Ulhasnagar.

events.title: Union Government approves the revised Lines 5 and 5A
events.summary: The report gives Rs 18,131 crore for both lines together, Rs 4,063 crore of it for Line 5A.

events.title: Every civil activity shown 100% complete
events.summary: MMRDA's progress table lists piling, piers, girders, station spines, wings and deck slabs as complete.

events.title: Overhead wires energised, Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka
events.summary: MMRDA powers 12.6 km of 25,000-volt wires, and the Kasheli depot tracks, ahead of trial runs.

events.title: Target: Phase 1 opens
events.summary: Reported target for passenger service from Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, after trial runs and safety approval.

events.title: Target: Bhiwandi to Kalyan, with Line 5A
events.summary: Reported target of 2030-31 for the rest of Line 5 and for Line 5A towards Ulhasnagar.
